labels.notes: Unmarked, REPORT status partial, as dispatched. (1) `line` (SFALine.lean:264-269) has exactly the type of the strict field Causal.Causality.BTZAxioms.line (Causal/SingularFlat.lean:168-169) at S₀ = SFALocal.sing M 0. A probe checked `type_of% B.line = type_of% (SFALine.line hC)` by `with_reducible rfl` for an arbitrary B : C.BTZAxioms (SFALocal.sing M 0), and that `{ B with line := SFALine.line hC }` elaborates. Per #check its only hypotheses beyond [TopologicalSpace M] and [SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) M] are [T2Space M] and IsoChartsCoverDEC25 (Flat.isom 2) C (minkowski 2) massAModelCausality. « No absolute minimality » is true: there is no hmin binder, and none can be hidden. It also asks no connectedness, no second countability, and C need not be the generated causality, so for this field Lean ≥ paper under the readings DEC-25, OQ-18 and the SFALocal reading of sing₀. It does not remove minimality from `btzAxioms`. That theorem carries hmin for the four other BTZAxioms fields, through SFABTZ.btzAxioms_of_line. Iminus_eq_empty genuinely needs minimality (SFALocalE0.e0_topTotal_separates), and the paper's generated causality has it (cor:massA_causalite, l.1396), so btzAxioms is not narrower than the paper. (2) isTranslationAtlas (l.186-218) builds the strict LineDevelopment.IsTranslationAtlas structure (Causal/LineDevelopment.lean:97-108) for any family of X_A-charts into E₀ that covers sing₀(M). Here τ = (e x).1, σ = axisInv and J = axisParams, and every field is discharged from the chart and SFABTZ.mem_sing_zero_iff. trans_tau (l.158-180) is one application of BPrimeE0.exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift (Causal/Port/BPrimeE0.lean:627, BTZ_1 prop:isom at α = β = 0, local form) to e.symm.trans e′. Its conclusion holds for every y near x, not only y ∈ sing₀, which is stronger than the field `trans` needs. causalCurveOn_symm_axis (l.128-145) comes from E0.axis_causalCurveOn through ChartIso.curveOn_symm and needs only ChartIso C E0.causality e. (3) btzAxioms gives C.BTZAxioms (SFALocal.sing M 0) at every T2 E≥0-manifold with hmin and hC. singularFlatAxioms_iff_massive_line is an iff whose right side is textually the field massive_line at sing = SFALocal.sing M: the probe fed B.massive_line from an arbitrary SingularFlatAxioms B back through it. (4) singularFlatAxioms_e0 is a genuine, full instance of the strict Causal.Causality.SingularFlatAxioms C (SFALocalE0.sing M). By #check its only hypotheses are [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] (hcov : E0Covered M) (hC : IsE0Natural C), beside the SingularGXStructure instance. E0Covered means that every singular point lies in an a.e. chart into E₀ (an E₀-manifold, DEC-25). IsE0Natural is the natural causality, unique by existsUnique_isE0Natural. The chain SFABTZ.singularFlatAxioms_iff_line_e0 → SFALocalE0.singularFlatAxioms_iff (⇐ builds all 19 fields one by one, massive_line vacuous since sing α = ∅ for α ≠ 0) hides no hypothesis. T2 and second countability are fields of the structure and part of « topological spacetime » (l.254). line_e0 and btzAxioms_e0 are the same rewrite through SFALocal.sing_eq_of_e0Covered and isoChartsCoverDEC25_of_e0. (5) Non-vacuity. A transitive constant-closure probe (deleted) shows that nonvacuous_e0 uses SFALine.singularFlatAxioms_e0, nonvacuous_e0_family uses SFALine.btzAxioms and line_e0_axis uses SFALine.line_e0. None of the three reaches Causal.E0.singularFlatAxioms, SFALocalE0.e0_singularFlatAxioms, SFALocal.e0_singularFlatAxioms or Causal.E0.btzAxioms. The witnesses have sing₀ = axis ≠ ∅, and E0.causality is causal, so the closed-embedding branch is exercised (line_e0_axis). The row stays partial: (a) for α > 0 is T-ett-sfa-massive-line, and the readings are OQ-18, OQ-34/OQ-35 and OQ-82.

labels.notes: This is a corollary beyond the target, cited unmarked (docstring l.8), and not an anchor. Jminus_eq_image (l.296-322) reads l.1347-1348 (J⁻(p) = {r = 0, τ ≤ τ(p)}, the half-line below p) at a BTZ point of M. Under [T2Space M], hmin, hC and C.IsCausal it gives the line γ through p, a closed embedding with γ 0 = p, inextensible and onto the component, with C.Jminus ⊤ {p} = γ '' Iic 0. γ is future-directed in C (CausalCurveIn inside Inextensible), so γ '' Iic 0 is the part of the line below p. The model form stays E0.causal_E0 / E0.Jminus_axis. The added hypothesis C.IsCausal is needed for the half-line shape and is disclosed in SCOPE (l.81-85), but its stated reason is imprecise (finding 3). isClosed_Jminus follows from the closed embedding. Neither declaration asks second countability. Since the file carries no ``**`label`**`` mark, tools/ledger.py associates it with no row by itself, so the master has to add it through extra_lean_files (finding 5).

findings.where: REPORT.json labels[0].findings[0] (« A citation of prop:isom at l.1530 would close the step at alpha = 0 with Hausdorff alone »)
findings.what: Finding 1 is a refinement of the curated second finding of lem:past_BTZ (« ETT.tex:1530 … the classification of connected 1-manifolds … is not cited … A citation of the classification, or of the development argument, would close the step »), not a new finding. That entry already says that the charts make the transitions translations. What finding 1 adds is the precise source at α = 0: brunswic2021cauchy prop:isom at α = β = 0 (BTZ_1.tex:378-384, not 378-383), formalized as BPrimeE0.exists_eqOn_rotE0_tauShift. That source is true and checked: rotE0 keeps .1 and tauShift adds t. But « a citation of prop:isom … would close the step » overstates. prop:isom gives only the translation transitions. The parametrisation still needs the development argument (LineDevelopment.exists_development) or the classification, and for a compact component it is periodic (the curated first finding). The Lean-side clauses (mixed E≥0-manifolds, no connectedness, second countability or minimality) belong in the notes, not in a paper finding.
findings.fix: Do not add finding 1 as a new paper_findings entry. Merge it into the existing second entry of lem:past_BTZ (replacement text under `curation.lem:past_BTZ.paper_findings_replace_second`), which also repairs that entry's « does without both … needs only M Hausdorff ».

findings.where: scaffold/CausalScaffold/SFALine.lean:84-85 (SCOPE, « `Jminus_eq_image` asks `C` causal for the same reason (on the circle `J⁻(p)` is the whole component) »)
findings.what: The reason given is imprecise. On the circle, γ is periodic, so γ '' Iic 0 is also the whole component, and the set equation J⁻(p) = γ '' Iic 0 does not fail there (by hand). What fails without causality is the closed-embedding conjunct, and with it the half-line shape of γ '' Iic 0. The proof uses causality for both: the closed embedding, and antisymmetry in the ⊆ direction. The statement and the need for the hypothesis are right; only the stated reason is off. REPORT finding 2's « Causality is needed for the half-line form » is correctly worded.
findings.fix: At graduation, reword to: « `Jminus_eq_image` asks `C` causal for the closed embedding, that is, for `γ '' Iic 0` to be a half-line: on the circle `γ` is periodic and `J⁻(p) = γ '' Iic 0` is the whole component ».

paper_findings_review.notes: defi:causal_E0 states the half-line in the model E₀, where it is true (E0.Jminus_axis), so it has no statement-level error. Both halves of the finding are true. At M, at every causal Hausdorff E≥0-manifold with its generated causality, J⁻(p) = γ(]−∞, 0]) (Causal.SFALine.Jminus_eq_image, Lean). At a non-causal M it fails as a half-line (by hand, correct): J⁻(p) lies in the component (SFABTZ.Jminus_subset_component), the axis of E₀/⟨τ ↦ τ + T⟩ closes into a causal loop through p, and so J⁻(p) is the whole circle. E₀/⟨τ ↦ τ + T⟩ is a connected, Hausdorff, second countable E₀-manifold, because τ-translation is an isometry acting freely and properly. Every use of the half-line in the body is in a causal M: prop:K_calcul (c) at l.1565-1573, and theo:geroch_sing at l.1783-1785, which needs only J⁻(p) ≠ {p}. The one overstatement is the introduction, l.294, which states it at every E≥0-manifold. It is sentence-level. Its Lean half belongs in the defi:causal_E0 notes. At most one new sentence-level paper finding at l.294 (text under `curation.defi:causal_E0.paper_findings_append_optional`).
